name: trello-golang-htmx
description: Kanban estilo Linear para gerenciar projetos de software (Go + HTMX + SQLite + Electron)
author: Alex Galhardo

scripts.build: bun run vendor && bun run css && bun scripts/build-go.ts
scripts.dev: bun run vendor && bun run css && bun scripts/dev.ts
scripts.lint: golangci-lint run ./... && golangci-lint fmt --diff && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && node --check internal/web/static/app.js && node --check internal/web/static/theme.js
scripts.e2e:desktop: bun run build && bun run desktop:build && playwright test --project=desktop
scripts.desktop:build: bun build desktop/main.ts --target=node --format=cjs --external electron --outfile desktop/dist/main.js && bun build desktop/preload.ts --target=node --format=cjs --external electron --outfile desktop/dist/preload.js
scripts.desktop: bun run build && bun run desktop:build && electron .
scripts.dist: bun run build && bun run desktop:build && electron-builder --config desktop/electron-builder.yml
